To calculate $17 \times 19$, you can use standard multiplication or a mental math trick.

**Method 1: Standard Multiplication**
$$
\begin{array}{r@{\quad}l}
  17 & \\
\times 19 & \\
\hline
 153 & (17 \times 9) \\
170 & (17 \times 10) \\
\hline
323 &
\end{array}
$$

**Method 2: Mental Math (Using the base of 20)**
You can think of 19 as $20 - 1$.
$$
17 \times 19 = 17 \times (20 - 1)
$$
$$
= (17 \times 20) - (17 \times 1)
$$
$$
= 340 - 17
$$
$$
= 323
$$

**Answer:**
323
